project.description: Publishes the daily log-level report from the export of loghub-daily-export.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail export_file="$EXPORT_DIR/${SOURCE}_levels.tsv" echo "[report] source=$SOURCE export=$export_file" if [ ! -f "$export_file" ]; then echo "ERROR: export not found: $export_file (No such file or directory); run loghub-daily-export first" exit 2 fi total=$(awk -F'\t' '{s += $2} END {print s + 0}' "$export_file") errors=$(awk -F'\t' '$1 == "ERROR" || $1 == "FATAL" {s += $2} END {print s + 0}' "$export_file") echo "[report] $SOURCE: $total classified lines, $errors ERROR/FATAL" mkdir -p "$EXPORT_DIR/reports" printf '%s,%s,%s\n' "$SOURCE" "$total" "$errors" > "$EXPORT_DIR/reports/${SOURCE}_summary.csv" echo "[report] published $EXPORT_DIR/reports/${SOURCE}_summary.csv"
